name: tpl-existence-1-goal
task: Pick up the key, then reach the goal.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task is an order — 'Pick up the key, then reach the goal' — but the only clause is Existence(at_goal), which lets the agent reach the goal without ever picking up the key. The missing requirement is that the key pickup must happen before reaching the goal. Add a hard Precedence(has_key, at_goal); the hard Existence(at_goal) with that Precedence then also forces has_key, so no separate Existence(has_key) is needed.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: the task orders two events — pick up the key (has_key) first, then reach the goal (at_goal). Existence(at_goal) hard requires the goal and Precedence(has_key, at_goal) hard puts has_key before it; together they force has_key, so no Existence(has_key) is needed and none was added. Both clauses trace to the task sentence and are hard as worded.

machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u3
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&has_key) -> u1
(u0, at_goal&!has_key) -> u2
(u0, at_goal&has_key) -> u3
(u1, at_goal) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&has_key, u1) -> 1
(u0, at_goal&!has_key, u2) -> -10
(u0, at_goal&has_key, u3) -> 12
(u1, at_goal, u3) -> 11
